May 11, 2018 - By Ruchi Gupta
Roundview Capital Llc increased its stake in Nike Inc Cl B (NKE) by 22.05% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Roundview Capital Llc bought 8,118 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.55% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 44,942 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.81 million, up from 36,824 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Roundview Capital Llc who had been investing in Nike Inc Cl B for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $109.47 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.04% or $0.03 during the last trading session, reaching $67.92. About 4.97 million shares traded. NIKE, Inc. (NYSE:NKE) has risen 18.31% since May 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.76% the S&P500.
Neumann Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in General Electric Co (GE) by 37.23% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Neumann Capital Management Llc sold 48,070 shares as the company’s stock declined 23.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 81,050 shares of the consumer electronics and appliances company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.41M, down from 129,120 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Neumann Capital Management Llc who had been investing in General Electric Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $127.59B market cap company. The stock increased 0.48% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $14.69. About 37.48M shares traded. General Electric Company (NYSE:GE) has declined 54.35% since May 11, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 65.90% the S&P500.
